title: A wardrobe swap
prompt:
Change exactly one letter in the name of a farm animal and you get a garment that you put on over your other clothes when it is cold.

Which farm animal is it?
hints: Which farm animals have short names that you could test one at a time?
Which letter of each name would you change: first, last, or one in the middle?
Try replacing the first letter of each animal's name with other letters. Which one gives something you could wear in winter?
solution:
**Goat.**

Change the G of GOAT to C and you get COAT, a garment worn over other clothes in cold weather.

Testing the farm animals one at a time works best. Changing the first letter is the most productive place to start, because many English word pairs differ only in their opening letter.
